CommunityApplications.Profile:
Firmware tooling for Unraid.
**fwupd-webui** puts a web UI on [fwupd](https://fwupd.org): it lists every device fwupd can enumerate on the server — NVMe drives, SATA disks, HBAs, network cards, Thunderbolt controllers, docks — with current firmware versions and any updates available from LVFS.
Unraid ships no fwupd and has no persistent package manager, so a container is the only practical way to get this on the platform.
It is read-only by default. Firmware flashing is disabled unless explicitly enabled, and even then every flash requires typing the device name to confirm, storage devices carry a data-loss warning, and system firmware (BIOS, UEFI capsule, SPI flash) is refused outright.
Support is via GitHub issues.
